parameters.query: SELECT step, data FROM wa_sessions WHERE phone = $1

INSERT INTO wa_sessions (phone, step, data, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, now())
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE
  SET step = EXCLUDED.step, data = EXCLUDED.data, updated_at = now();

INSERT INTO wa_wifi_change_log (phone, cpf, contrato_id, ssid_novo, sucesso, resposta_sgp)
SELECT a->>'phone', a->>'cpf', a->>'contrato', a->>'ssid_novo',
       (a->>'sucesso')::boolean, a->'resposta_sgp'
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS a) t;
